about: PSA grading backlog and the reopening of the Value tiers. Readings are PSA's own figures (millions of units, published every other Tuesday on its Backlog Tracker page and in its update notes; the first four copied from screenshots; later ones read from PSA's page by the full check, step 8i). threshold_m is the line PSA's tracker shows for 'Value Tiers Open'. 'projection' is plain arithmetic on the readings (scripts/psa_backlog.py), three scenarios for the next drops, not a forecast: PSA has to assess and announce after the backlog is under the line, and the Value tiers' prices, caps and turnaround may differ when they return. value_prices is PSA Japan's price chart that applied from 2026-02-10 (before the pause); PSA Japan corrected in the comments that Value Max's declared-value cap is 150,000 yen, not 80,000. Edit with scripts/psa_backlog.py. check = when the full check last looked at PSA's page (it looks from the day after an update is expected, daily until there is a newer one).
source: PSA Backlog Tracker and update notes, screenshots from Philipp 2026-10-10

check.result: backfilled 7/14, 7/28, 8/11 from the page; newest is still 10/06

readings.note: Peak: up from 11M (45-day eligibility wave, convention season); Plano hub opened
Down from 12.4M; July set a record for graded units
PSA: could evaluate reopening a service tier this month if the pace holds

Six hubs; PSA: on path to assess reopening additional service tiers in the coming months

tiers.name: Value tiers (Bulk, Value, Value Plus, Value Max)
tiers.note: Paused per PSA Japan. The tracker shows them as open below 5M units. Value and Bulk orders sent before the pause keep priority over new Standard orders.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.note: Launched 2026-09-14 per PSA's update (earlier notes here said 09-10). Turnaround is the quoted ~100 business days, which may run longer while earlier Value and Bulk orders are ahead of it.

value_prices.note: PSA Japan chart, tax included, per card. Before the pause; may change when the tiers return.

scenarios.label: Average pace holds
scenarios.rule: each update drops 0.90M, the average of the last 3 drops

scenarios.label: Latest pace holds
scenarios.rule: each update drops 0.80M, like the last one

scenarios.label: Slowdown continues
scenarios.rule: the drop keeps shrinking by 0.10M per update until it reaches zero
